name: geant4-claude
description: Design, run, and analyze Geant4 simulations for user-defined detectors. Geant4 and ROOT run in a pinned apptainer image; analysis runs with uproot. Skill-driven; works on Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Build, run, and analyze Geant4 detector simulations.
interface.longDescription: Design a detector, build and run a Geant4 simulation in a pinned apptainer image, and analyze the output with uproot — all through skills. geant4-init scaffolds a project and the shared engine; geant4-task creates a task subdir per simulation; geant4-detector/example/preview/build/run/analyze/validate drive the flow.
defaultPrompt: Simulate a 1 GeV e- on a lead block.
